sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Deepansi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
2.
The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.183 of 2024 under sections 363, 366, 376 IPC and Section 5/6 POCSO Act, and section 3(2)5 SC/ST Act, P.S. Jayas, District Amethi.
3. The FIR in question was lodged as a missing person report alleging that the daughter of the informant was enticed by the applicant.
Subsequently, in the statement under section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., the victim did not support the prosecution story and admitted that she had gone to Lucknow and then at Ghaziabad.
The tentative age of the victim has been assessed as 19 years.

entities.text: Mohd. Faizan vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the statement under section 161 Cr.P.C., not supporting the prosecution and the statement under section 164 Cr.P.C. admitting that the victim stayed with the applicant for two days at Lucknow and Delhi, a case for bail is made out more so when the applicant is in custody since 07.06.2024 and has no criminal history.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Mohd. Faizan be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty Thousand) each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 12.9.2024 VNP/-
